paragraphs.text:
Your car is uncomfortable, but at least you’ll avoid the local folk, 
who seem none too friendly. When you awake, you are cold and 
stiff, but you feel ready for anything. To explore the pyramid, go 
to 360. Or you can return to Cairo in 48 hours and go to any 
Cairo location on the Egypt Location Table. 
(444)
